method: Complete named explanatory fields from the exact subject/pointer. Original summaries, subjects and historical reviews unchanged. This is an excerpt, not a standalone replacement contract or review.

summary.answer: Accept dialogbundle and dialogkey. If either is undefined, explicitly return undefined. Otherwise read dynamic field dialogbundle.(dialogkey) into dialogalias. If that result is undefined, use a bare return. Read voiceprefix only after a defined alias; if the prefix is defined, replace alias with voiceprefix+dialogalias. Return the resulting alias. A defined empty or false value is not rejected by a truthiness test. No external state is written; dynamic field and concatenation type semantics remain VM-dependent.
unknowns: VM dynamic field access and concatenation for malformed types
whether bare return and explicit undefined are bytecode-equivalent; preserved as distinct source forms

summary.answer: Accept chancekey. Synchronously call same-namespace mpdialog_value(chancekey) once and store dialogchance. Undefined or <=0 returns false. Otherwise >=100 returns true without randomint. For the remaining comparison path, return randomint(100)<dialogchance. This records a threshold comparison, not a measured probability or a verified distribution of the engine RNG. No clamping, numeric/type conversion or retries occur locally.
unknowns: mpdialog_value result and effective session/dialog data
native randomint range/distribution and VM comparisons for malformed values
